q: Why did my sales drop yesterday?

checks.what: tool: measures the change with compare_period

answer:
Sales did not drop — they rose. Net sales (order date) were ₹91,220 on 2026-10-13 compared to ₹40,119 on 2026-10-12, an increase of 127.4%. Yesterday was a stronger day, not a decline.

What changed (order-date figures)
- Biggest drivers: Orders rose 26 → 45 (+73.1%) and Net AOV rose ₹1,543 → ₹2,027 (+31.4%); orders explain ~66% of the sales move and AOV ~34% of it.  
- Channel concentration: Meta ad-driven sales jumped from ₹6,290 → ₹47,854 and accounted for about 81% of the increase versus the comparison day. Google also rose but at smaller scale.  
- Other movements: Discounts increased (₹1,553 → ₹5,173), which slightly reduced net sales; net sales deductions rose modestly (₹5,110 → ₹6,569). Conversion rate improved (0.46% → 1.08%) and sessions were roughly flat (3,254 → 3,434).

Confidence and caveats
- The period totals and the component split are exact; however a few tax lines failed to fetch (non-critical for this headline). Today’s and intraday data are partial; these numbers are full-day for the dates shown.

Worth checking: did you mean a different comparison date or the finance (P&L) basis? I can drill into product-level or campaign/ad-level contributors on 2026-10-13 if you want.
